item.tib: dbal gsas las rim gyis bsdus don nyer mkho nyung
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di nas khyung po btsun chung tha yid wer ya tshul ming gis sbyor ba dge zhing zhal dro bkra shis par gyur cig …
item.note: the zhang-zhung name of the author, to follow the glossaries, would seem to correspond to tibetan yid-bzhin rgyal-ba tshul-khrims, or something similar. see dpal-tshul, history (tbmc edition), vol. 2, p. 478, line 1, for a khyung-po yi[d]-bzhin rgyal-ba, who might be our author. ytkc gives a very similar title saying it was composed by 'a-zha blo-gros rgyal-mtshan, but this could have resulted from a misinterpretation of the zhang-zhung name.
